Variants.Content: Entry The Fangs of Frost and Snow are a tall mountain range north of the Great Wall that runs through the Great Wall. Peaks, glaciers, wind vents and closed valleys separate and barely connect the tribes of free people. It's not an easy border to cross: snowmelt in the summer can bring rapids, and snow in the winter can Mountain tribes such as Thern developed their own languages, rituals and survival techniques here. Southerners often regard Frostfang as the end of the map, but free folk regard it as the path traveled by their ancestors, a hunting ground and a homeland that is difficult to leave.
